title: Chick on a Magic Branch
description: A large yellow cartoon chick with an angry expression and a bow tie stands on a twisted green tree branch, raising one fist. The branch emerges from a giant red circular frame decorated with patterns, set against a bright landscape with rolling green hills, a yellow sun, small houses, a black furry creature, a purple robot, and a floating purple ghost below.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a large angry yellow cartoon chick with red gloves and a black bow tie standing on a gnarled green tree branch that grows through a giant decorative red circular frame. Below are a small black furry creature, a purple robot, and a translucent purple ghost with a surprised face. The background shows rolling green hills, distant houses, a bright yellow sun with rays in a blue sky, with sparkles and magical green energy trails, in a vibrant colorful illustrative style.
